meta.name: Hollywood Arts
meta.description:
Class is in session at Hollywood Arts! Self-proclaimed icon Trina Vega returns to steer gifted teens toward stardom, status and hilarious havoc.

Rated TV-G · Returning Series · First aired 15 Oct 2026 · United States of America · Language: English
Studio: Paramount Television Studios, Nickelodeon Productions, Quick to Judge · Network: Netflix

Complete series. On your server: S1 12/12

On your server — Audio: English

videos.title: Back to School
videos.overview: Struggling actress Trina Vega returns to Hollywood Arts to chase industry connections — and a student showcase that may offer long-awaited redemption.

videos.title: Fake It 'Till Ya Make It
videos.overview: When an emergency casting call prompts resume panic, Trina has an easy fix: just lie! Jen and Pepper race to outskill each other; Emmy must cry on cue.

videos.title: Underworld Understudy
videos.overview: When a cold sidelines Oscar from starring in the school play, Emmy swaps the tech booth for the spotlight — leaving Trina to wreak havoc on the controls.

videos.title: He Sang She Sang
videos.overview: It's boys versus girls at the Battle of the Bands! Emmy's attempt to reunite Trina with her old girl group flops, forcing a last-minute improvisation.

videos.title: Tori's Magic Locker
videos.overview: A myth that Tori Vega's old locker grants wishes sparks an acting contest that derails Qwest's date and adds fuel to Oscar and Emmy's sibling rivalry.

videos.title: Cheese Men
videos.overview: After a ukulele-bashing spree reveals Trina's mess of a love life, the class relies on Qwest's rom-com expertise to set her up with a familiar face.

videos.title: Cattle Call
videos.overview: Trina promises the class a thrilling field trip, but the crew gets a salty reality check when it turns out to be a cattle call for a pretzel commercial.

videos.title: Subway Showdown
videos.overview: Pepper helps her pals save face after getting served in a viral dance-off. Trina and Jen bicker their way into a callback for mother-daughter duos.

videos.title: Puppet Love
videos.overview: When Jen's TV debut gets axed, the crew plots a heist to steal the raw footage. Trina uses a puppet to pull on heartstrings at Robbie's party.

videos.title: Party Crashers
videos.overview: Trina's gung-ho challenge to seize new opportunities lands Qwest a high-profile DJ gig, but things get messy when his meddling friends crash the party.

videos.title: Hollywood Arts & Sciences
videos.overview: When a major donor pulls the school's funding, the crew stages an elaborate scheme to win it back — but an improvised line makes the plan go up in smoke.

videos.title: A Faire to Remember
videos.overview: Drama brews at the school's Ren Faire as a potion-fueled love triangle forms and Emmy strikes a star-crossed connection with Oscar's archnemesis.
